semantics: Sample in on every rising edge. Idle zero begins frame; next eight samples fill bits 0 through 7. A one at the ninth sample validates frame and pulses done. A zero at expected stop enters recovery; first later one returns to idle without reporting an invalid byte. Next sample may start a new frame.
latency_reset: done asserted immediately after valid stop sampling edge for one cycle; active-high synchronous reset aborts reception and clears done. out_byte meaningful only with done.
ambiguities: Interpret assert done each time it finds a stop bit as valid expected stop only, consistent with correctly received byte requirement; recovery delimiter does not validate malformed frame.
verification_plan: All 256 byte values with back-to-back frames
